verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
SAAYUUNI mu ggulu,
Katonda gy'abeera;
Bwe ndifa,ndigenda
N'essanyu lingi nnyo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
-Omulokozi gy'ali,
Gwe baayigganyanga;
Ne bamalayika
Bayimba-ettendo lye.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ab'edda baali-eyo,
Baakomekkereza
Emgendo Zaabwe,era
Baalaba Mukama.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Eri n'abatume
Gye balabikira;
Bonna-abamwesiga,
Nga bakuba-ennanga

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Katonda wang(e),eyo gy'oli
Ndituuka dd(i) okukulaba?
